use_case_summary: Primary: real-time agent assist for voice+chat. Streaming suggestions surfaced in agent UI (interruption-aware). Secondary: automatic ticket summarization post-call, tool-calls to CRM and ticketing systems, and reranking prior suggestions. Must support function/tool-calling with deterministic audit logs.
sla_and_tech_constraints: Target SLOs: p50 <60ms token generation, p95 <180ms for suggestion completion on 8k context with continuous batching; throughput target 300 concurrent agents, burst to 1500 for marketing spikes. Require VPC private control plane, HSM/KMS for key management, and options for on-prem connector. Need retention controls and ability to redact transcripts before storage.
